source_text: Terram in qua dormis dabo tibi et semini. Benedictio Abrahae transit in Iacob fugientem.
pass_a_gloss: Land in which you-sleep I-will-give to-you and to-seed. Blessing of-Abraham passes into Jacob fleeing.
pass_b_english: [[The land on which you sleep I will give to you and to your seed >> Bible:Genesis 28:13]]. Abraham’s blessing passes to fleeing Jacob.
